name: Authentik
summary: Self-hosted Identity Provider (OAuth2/OIDC/SAML/LDAP) with SSO, MFA and a policy engine. Deploys authentik server + worker on a managed PostgreSQL database.
description: Authentik is an open-source Identity Provider that centralises authentication across all your apps. This one-click template deploys the full Authentik stack: server (API + UI + SSO flows), worker (background tasks) and a managed PostgreSQL database, pre-wired over Railway private networking with an auto-generated secret key. No manual environment variables required.

services.name: Postgres
services.note: Keep the service name exactly 'Postgres' so the ${{Postgres.*}} references below resolve.

healthcheck.note: Readiness endpoint; returns 200 only when the PostgreSQL connection is up. First boot runs migrations, so keep the timeout generous.

volume.note: Persists media, uploaded icons/backgrounds and certs. Required: without it files are lost on redeploy.

resources.note: Authentik's server needs ~300-500MB idle plus headroom. 1GB is the recommended default.

variables.description: Tells Railway which port to route and healthcheck.
Secret key used for cookie signing. Generated once at deploy time and shared with the worker.
PostgreSQL host via Railway private network.
PostgreSQL port via Railway private network.
Gunicorn worker processes. Lowered to 1 to fit small instances; raise if the instance is busy.
Keep error reporting off for a clean, minimal deployment. Optional.

publicNetworking.note: No public access. The worker only talks to Postgres over the private network.

healthcheck.note: The worker has no HTTP listener, so no healthcheck path. Railway's restart policy restarts it if it crashes.

resources.note: The Rust worker entrypoint in 2026.5 uses ~300MB less memory than older versions.

variables.description: Must be identical to the server's secret key. Read from the shared variable.
PostgreSQL host via Railway private network.
PostgreSQL port via Railway private network.

sharedVariables.description: Random 64-char hex secret (32 bytes), generated once when the template is deployed.
sharedVariables.fallback: If the template composer does not expose shared variables, define this on authentik-server and reference it from authentik-worker as ${{authentik-server.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}}.

estimatedCostPerMonthUSD.note: Exceeds the $5 Hobby monthly credit. New accounts start with a one-time $5 trial credit. See README for current Railway pricing.

notes: No Redis: authentik 2026.5+ dropped Redis. The task queue (Dramatiq) and cache run on PostgreSQL, matching upstream's official docker-compose.
Storage path is /data in 2026.x (replaced the old /media mount).
Admin setup happens through the out-of-the-box wizard at /if/flow/initial-setup/ on first boot. No bootstrap variables are pre-set on purpose: the user picks their own akadmin password.
Pin policy: the image tag is fixed to a specific release. Never use :latest in a published template.
The initial-setup flow and /if/admin/ login page are served by authentik on PORT=9000 over Railway's HTTPS public domain.
